Mission Local’s short “People We Meet” piece was about three friends who arrived at the GameStop on Mission Street at 6 a.m. to wait for the physical release of “The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom.” They brought folding chairs and snacks, and worked remotely while they waited for the shop to open.
